GitHub #375's second design (mitcad#1945, mitcad#1954; opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/fillet-exact-reported-test.cmake): GitHub #403's fifth design (the stepped block, Fillet1 F12 of radius d5 = 5 on eleven edges, the inner edge of the step among them) and then Chamfer1 (F13) of 4 mm on the back's bottom edge. Its untrimmed faces were the slivers of the fillet built 0.1 % smaller; then (mitcad#1954) the fillet was refused in words. Now (mitcad#2068) the ball rolls between the roundings of the lower top and the wall (the core's inner corner closed by a disc of 10) and the chamfer cuts the block cleanly: both build, no warning, no face under 0.01 mm2, the volume the rounded block's (625 pi - 500) / 3 + 21.2367565 (geometry.suite.dressup_takes_face) less the chamfer's 4 x 4 / 2 x 10. At 2.4 both build too.
